content_of_post_to_comment: If we’re going to have the death penalty, we should use either a guillotine or a firing squad. Those are probably the quickest, most painless ways of ending a human life… and there’s no shortage of Americans who know how to fire a gun, unlike administering lethal drugs, which takes a technical know-how that far fewer people have. But those methods look bloody and barbaric, so we resort to lethal injection, which sounds humane but is actually a lot more drawn-out and painful for the person being put to death. We want the death penalty, but we don’t want to face the full truth about what state-sanctioned killing entails, so we choose a method that obscures that truth from us, makes us feel good about ourselves, while passing off the pain onto the prisoner. Let’s acknowledge the inherent ugliness of the death penalty, and how every attempt to mitigate that ugliness has failed, and then we can have a reasonable conversation about whether or not to continue it.
